grokFacts.heading: Grok Build model settings
grokFacts.existingValue: Existing native value kept; not displayed.
grokFacts.defaultState: Not written: Grok Build resolves its own default.
grokFacts.imageDefaultState: Not written: Grok Build uses its endpoint model metadata.
grokFacts.effortDefaultState: Not written: Grok Build uses its endpoint model metadata.
grokFacts.effortUnavailableState: Not written: no explicit, supported effort list can be injected; existing native fields stay unchanged.

notes.context: The context window is a model capacity used by Grok Build, not a request output limit. This plan does not change the default model.
notes.reasoning: When the native field is absent, declared effort levels and the model default are written as reasoning_efforts. Existing lists and deprecated supports_reasoning_effort or reasoning_effort stay unchanged; their presence does not prove Provider support, and the native menu is not verified in a running session.
notes.requestSettings: Maximum output capacity and tool-call capability have no verified independent native declaration in this adapter yet. Existing request parameters are preserved; no request tuning controls are provided.

sources.library: Saved in the model library; the origin is not recorded.
sources.userDeclaration: Declared by you in the model settings.

states.unchanged: Not written: the value already in the file stays.
states.notStated: Not written: Pi's own default applies.

notes.requestSettings: This injects the saved model definition, not request tuning. Existing request parameters stay unchanged. Pi has no model-definition tool-call flag; this does not mean the model cannot use tools.
notes.maxOutput: Pi reads the maximum output as the model's limit, not as a per-request output limit.
notes.precedence: Project settings, command-line options and resumed sessions can override a saved thinking level. vibemate reads only the user settings file.

modelConfig.preferencePreview: Remembered effort requires the desktop app. This preview does not invent a saved choice.
modelConfig.preferenceScope: Remembering saves only a starting choice for this provider/model in vibemate. It does not write Agent configuration; preview and apply are separate actions.
modelConfig.preferenceSaved: Choice remembered. Agent configuration has not changed.

preferenceErrors.storage_unavailable: Preference storage is unavailable. Restart vibemate before trying again.
preferenceErrors.read_failed: The remembered effort could not be read. Reload the saved choice.
preferenceErrors.write_failed: The choice could not be remembered. The previous preference is unchanged; you can retry.
preferenceErrors.invalid_request: The preference request was not valid. Reload the saved choice.
preferenceErrors.not_found: This provider or model no longer exists. Select a saved binding again.
preferenceErrors.invalid_stored_data: Stored preference or model data is invalid. It was not replaced with a default.
preferenceErrors.model_changed: Model metadata changed. Reload the saved choice and review the available efforts.
preferenceErrors.preference_changed: Another save changed this preference. Reload the saved choice before editing again.
preferenceErrors.effort_not_mapped: This effort is not mapped for the current model. Reload and choose a supported value or Do not overwrite.
preferenceErrors.operation_failed: The save or read could not be confirmed. Reload the saved choice before retrying.
preferenceErrors.desktop_required: Remembering effort requires the vibemate desktop app.
preferenceErrors.invalid_response: The preference response could not be verified. Reload the saved choice before retrying.

outcome.applied: Written. The settings file now holds the planned keys.
outcome.failed: Nothing was written; the settings file still holds its previous content.
outcome.compensated: The write was rolled back; the settings file holds its previous content again.

outcome.unknown: The result for one file could not be verified. Review the settings file before trying again.

modelConfig.applyPreviewAgain: Preview again to see the current state of the file.

writeErrors.target_unreadable: the file could not be read

writeErrors.backup_unavailable: the backup could not be stored

notices.credentialFromStore: The API key stays out of this window. When the change is applied, vibemate reads it from OS credential storage and writes it into the settings file as plain text.
notices.overridesNotChecked: Managed settings, project settings and shell environment variables were not read. They can override this file.
notices.modelKeyOverridden: The existing "model" setting ({{value}}) is overridden by the environment variable.
notices.envKeyOverridden: The "{{value}}" entry already names an environment variable for its key. Grok resolves api_key ahead of env_key, so the planned key takes over that entry; the existing line is left untouched.
notices.providerLimited: The vendor guarantees this route only for Anthropic first-party models.
notices.contextWindowNotMapped: This model has a saved context capacity, but window mapping currently supports only DeepSeek deepseek-flash without [1m]. The existing window declaration and compaction settings are left unchanged and may still affect this model.

errors.base_url_unverified: This configuration does not use the verified gateway address for its provider, so no plan was built.
errors.target_path_invalid: The settings file path cannot be used.
errors.target_unreadable: The settings file could not be read or is not a JSON object. Nothing was changed.
errors.target_too_large: The settings file is larger than the preview limit and was not read.
errors.target_conflict: The settings file holds a conflicting value where this change has to go (wrong type, existing model alias or entry, or unsafe overwrite). The configuration was left unchanged.
errors.thinking_level_unavailable: This thinking level is not declared for the model, or Pi does not accept it in the model definition. Choose another level; nothing was written.
errors.storage_unavailable: Local configuration storage is unavailable. Restart vibemate.
errors.provider_not_found: That provider configuration is no longer saved.
errors.model_not_found: That provider no longer has this saved model.
errors.plan_stale: The configuration changed since the preview, so nothing was written. Preview again.
errors.credential_missing: No API key is saved for this provider in OS credential storage.
errors.credential_unavailable: The OS credential store could not be read. Unlock it and try again.
errors.location_unavailable: The Agent configuration directory could not be located.
errors.operation_failed: The preview could not be built. Try again.
errors.desktop_required: Applying configuration needs the vibemate desktop app.
errors.invalid_response: The desktop app returned an unexpected plan.
errors.agent_version_unverified: This Pi installation does not expose the compatible model/settings format. Check its entry path and installation; stable Pi 1.x releases from 1.2 are supported when their configuration schemas match.
errors.grokAgentVersionUnverified: This Grok Build installation does not match the verified configuration contract. Check its entry path and installation; the discovered version must be 1.0.60 or a later 1.0 patch, `.metadata_version` under the Grok home directory must match that version, and `docs/user-guide/26-config-reference.md` must include the verified fields.
errors.claudeAgentVersionUnverified: This Claude Code installation has no verified configuration contract. Check its entry path and installation.
errors.protocol_unsupported: The selected model has no verified native request protocol.
errors.credential_conflict: auth.json contains a credential for this managed provider that would override the planned key. Resolve it in Pi and preview again.
errors.credentialConflictGeneric: A higher-priority credential for this managed provider would override the planned key. Resolve the conflict and preview again.

modelConfig.piRestartRequired: Start a new Pi session to use these defaults. Project settings, CLI options and resumed sessions can override them.
modelConfig.piNotice: The API key is read from OS credential storage only when you apply, then written as plain text in models.json. Existing files are backed up before replacement. Declared model capabilities and verified thinking mappings are injected; the saved default is a separate choice.
modelConfig.grokRestartRequired: Start a new Grok Build session for this entry to take effect. CLI options, shell environment variables and policy files can override the settings file.

notifications.partial: Some changes remain. Check files and backups.
notifications.unknown: Write result unknown. Check files and backups.

modelConfig.grokOutcomeApplied: Written. Grok Build's configuration now holds the planned model entry.

piOutcome.applied: Written. Both Pi configuration files now hold the planned settings.
piOutcome.failed: Nothing was written; the previous Pi configuration is intact.
piOutcome.compensated: The write was rolled back; the previous Pi configuration is restored.
piOutcome.partial: Some changes could not be undone. Review the files and backups before retrying.
piOutcome.unknown: A file result could not be verified. Review the files and backups before retrying.

resolution.title: Interrupted write review
resolution.required: This write has interrupted journal results. Inspect them before restoring.
resolution.notice: This review only records what the files match now. It does not prove who wrote them, change configuration, restore backups, or make a running Agent reload. Any restore requires a separate preview and confirmation.
resolution.empty: No interrupted mutations remain. Close this review and recheck history.
resolution.blocked: These observations cannot be settled safely. A file may have changed, a backup may be unavailable, or a newer mutation may supersede this one. Keep the files and backups, resolve the cause, then inspect again; no configuration was changed.
resolution.recorded: Observations recorded; journal state: {{state}}. Configuration files were not changed. Preview a restore separately if needed.

errors.operation_not_found: That recorded write no longer exists in this Agent's history. Recheck the list.
errors.plan_stale: Files, backups or journal records changed since inspection. Inspect again; this action does not restore configuration.
errors.invalid_request: The observation-review request was not valid. Inspect the write again.
errors.storage_unavailable: The configuration journal is unavailable. Recheck history or restart vibemate.
errors.operation_failed: The observations could not be recorded or verified. Recheck history and inspect again; this action never restores configuration.
errors.desktop_required: Reviewing and recording observations needs the vibemate desktop app.
errors.invalid_response: The desktop app returned an unexpected observation result. Recheck history before trying again.

stages.completed: file result recorded; legacy step result missing

matches.previous: Current file matches only the pre-mutation state.
matches.intended: Current file matches only the intended state.
matches.both: Both states match; the result remains ambiguous.
matches.diverged: Current file matches neither recorded state.
matches.unreadable: Current file cannot be safely read.

backups.not_needed: The pre-mutation state was absence; no backup file is needed.
backups.available: The independent pre-mutation backup is available and its digest matches.
backups.unavailable: The independent pre-mutation backup is missing, damaged or unreadable.

restore.title: Configuration history
restore.previewMode: The browser preview cannot read configuration files or the write history. Open the Agents page in the vibemate desktop app.
restore.empty: vibemate has not written this configuration yet.
restore.loadMoreFailed: More history could not be read: {{error}}

statuses.unrecorded: Does not match any retained history version.
statuses.partial: Only some managed files match a retained history version.
statuses.unreadable: At least one managed file could not be read safely.

backups.not_needed: Pre-mutation absence; no backup file is needed.
backups.available: Independent pre-mutation backup is available and matches its digest.
backups.unavailable: Independent pre-mutation backup is missing, damaged or unreadable.

restore.previewFor: Restore preview for the write made {{time}}
restore.nothingToRestore: This write has nothing to restore in its current state.
restore.conflictHint: Open the file and decide what to keep, then recheck and preview again. vibemate never overwrites a file that changed after its write.
restore.keyNotice: The restored file gets back whatever it held before this write, including a plain text API key if it contained one. OS credential storage is not changed.
restore.restoredOwnerNamed: The content that comes back was written by the Provider {{name}}.
restore.restoredOwnerRemoved: The content that comes back was written for {{id}}, a Provider no longer in the library.
restore.restoredOwnerUnknown: The content that comes back was not written by vibemate: it was edited by hand or by another tool.

actions.remove: Remove the file this write created
actions.conflict: Left alone: the file changed after this write

reasons.target_changed: the file changed after this write
reasons.symlink_refused: the path is a symbolic link
reasons.target_unreadable: the file could not be read
reasons.target_too_large: the file is larger than the restore limit
reasons.backup_unavailable: the stored copy is missing or no longer matches its digest
reasons.write_failed: the previous content could not be written back
reasons.outcome_unknown: the result could not be verified
reasons.log_write_failed: the operation could not be recorded
reasons.log_read_failed: the operation log could not be read
reasons.invalid_stored_operation: a recorded operation is not valid
reasons.restore_history_unknown: this write did not record whether the file existed before it, so removing it cannot be shown to be safe

outcome.compensated: The write is undone; the file holds the content it had before it.
outcome.partial: Some files were left alone. They still hold what the write put there.
outcome.unknown: The result for one file could not be verified. Check the file before trying again.
outcome.failed: Nothing was restored; the files still hold what the write left.

restore.stepRemoved: {{path}} — file created by this write removed
restore.leftoversHeading: These private copies could not be removed:
restore.leftoverHint: They hold content that is no longer referenced by any recorded write. Only your user account can read them; delete them yourself if you do not want to keep them.
restore.resultHint: Recheck to see the current state, then preview again if a file still needs attention.

errors.operation_not_found: That recorded write no longer exists. Recheck the list.
errors.plan_stale: A file changed since the preview, so nothing was written. Preview again.
errors.invalid_request: The restore request was not valid.
errors.storage_unavailable: Local configuration storage is unavailable; restart vibemate.
errors.operation_failed: The restore could not be completed. Try again.
errors.desktop_required: Restoring configuration needs the vibemate desktop app.
errors.invalid_response: The desktop app returned an unexpected restore answer.

delete.label: Delete this record and its backups
delete.title: Delete configuration history entry?
delete.body: This deletes the saved configuration and its own snapshots. Other versions, current Agent files, credentials, and recovery logs with their backups are kept. This cannot be undone.
delete.leftoversHeading: These private copies could not be removed:
delete.leftoverHint: The history row may still exist. Fix permissions and retry; do not assume the record is gone.

blocked.history_active: This operation is still unfinished, so it cannot be deleted.
blocked.history_unresolved: Interrupted writes still need review before deletion.
blocked.history_referenced: Other history still depends on this entry, so it cannot be deleted.

errors.operation_not_found: This history entry is already gone. Recheck the list.
errors.plan_stale: Something changed since the attempt, so nothing was deleted. Recheck.
errors.invalid_request: The delete request is not valid.
errors.storage_unavailable: Local configuration storage is unavailable. Restart vibemate.
errors.operation_failed: The delete could not finish. Try again.
errors.history_active: This operation is still unfinished, so it cannot be deleted.
errors.history_unresolved: Interrupted writes still need review before deletion.
errors.history_referenced: Other history still depends on this entry, so it cannot be deleted.
errors.desktop_required: Deleting configuration history requires the vibemate desktop app.
errors.invalid_response: The desktop app returned an unexpected delete result.
